items.note: N1 states the copy/gather/scatter/side-injection network, the signed exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) and restoration of scratch wires, but omits h=100, the triple indexing and the neighbour rules. The method follows the paper's schedule and the forward/inverse/forward composition (762-763), but it never gives the central coefficients |S∩T| mod 2 and (|S∩T|-1)/2 or how the side wires cancel them (752-758), which is the essential computation.

N2 states D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} with edge operators D_vD_u^{-1}. Its method (the stored array equals the frame applied to the logical array, and a common frame commutes with a pointwise linear gate) is exactly the paper's invariant proof at 804-817.

The plan states nested nondegenerate labels in the m-dimensional F^{⊗3}, the single decreasing edge type (central 3->4, loss h) and the ratios 100/539 and 101/539. It never states L=Ich or the budget sum |Δdim| = Wm-2N+2L, only 'below W·m', and its sub-steps quote the lemma's conclusion rather than the residual table, the telescoping or the orthogonality of neighbouring triple lines (1012-1071).

N4 states the projections P_U, the source matrix -P_{U_a}, the endpoint identity I_m and s_b<W_b m, and N4.1 gives the deficit N-2L_b, which is equivalent to s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b. The method says that rank equals dimension change but omits the N exceptional source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one (1162-1165), which is where the extra N ranks come from.

N5 describes the phase frames only as i^{wt(P_Ux) mod 4}, without the H^{⊗m} conjugation of 1193, and gives s_c<W_c m without the formula W_c m-2N+2L_c. The route matches the paper: weight additive mod 4 on orthogonal vectors, one kernel per orthonormal residual vector, telescoping, and C=iZC^{-1}Z with 27k inverse factors on X_a->Y_a.

The chain L/N<1/2, deficit N-2L_b>0, deficits above 20·2^{-50}, s/W<m^τ with τ=1-2^{-50} is present. It omits the exact η_b and η_c and the step log m<20, which gives m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20·2^{-50}) (1332-1338), so the exponent inequality is asserted rather than derived.

T1 omits the fixed permutation of two digit values, and T2 omits the hypothesis that the offset is prepared in b^{O(1)} time. The split/aligned-scan/merge argument and the cut-at-Q-a re-merge for controlled shifts are the paper's proofs (514-527, 575-604).

Both lemmas are stated exactly. The elimination (topmost row, rightmost entry), the conjugation by E_2, E_1^{-1}, and the one-interchange pivot sandwiched between two controlled shifts follow 1376-1443.

The plan covers every part of the proof: the row split into W role streams of volume V/W, Φ_{A_e} on edges with pointwise gates giving H<-H+D, the three shears, s calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) solved to O(e^τ), and the parking-stack schedule at O(V) per node.

Follows the paper's proof: top ρ digits joined into a row field with q^{2ρ}>=W^k, padding to a multiple of W^k, a base-m decomposition into power-width calls summing geometrically, and binary-to-[q^e] padding.
States conjugation by P_M into coordinate kernels, s_c forward children on f=e/m axes with inverses via C^{-1}=-iZCZ, row additions for M, and H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D. These follow 1852-1931.

The time bound is given as O(V(L^τ+1)) 'plus negligible repair terms' instead of the explicit MA^3+δ_bad MA(R+A) terms and the family conditions under which they vanish. The derivation (two parity three-cycles, packed cyclic shifts, guard interval [10,2^{K-1}-11], union bound 80(f-1)2^{-K}, radix-sort repair, final two-bit XOR) follows 2016-2207.

The node overhead, row source, recurrence F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^τ+1) and base-m pieces are present. The leaf cutoff e<d^β with F(e)=O(e), the bound K<=e^{c/β}, the leaf contribution O(e^σ d^{β(1-σ)}) and the condition λ'>σ+β(1-σ) (2403-2444) are missing, and L2.3 claims the whole sum is O(e^λ).

Together, L, L3 and L4.2 state the O(Vd^{λ'}) layer, exact evaluation with Δ=⌈C_0d^{C_1}⌉ guard bits from A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, Δ=o(p), and the single truncation error below √2·2^{-p}. These follow the guard-width section and the proof at 2686-2757.

Character cancellation by the shift t/2^{v+1}, DIF recursion, bit-reversed storage B_tF_t^-, opposite F_t^+B_t^{-1}, layout L by prefix moves and chunk exchanges, cost O(Tp[dK+pK^{τ-1}+ℓd^{λ'}]) and error √2ℓ2^{-p}. All match the paper.
Evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, four products with the established multiplier, centered residues using |h_j|<B_0/2, negacyclic reduction and O(rp log(rp)) match 3237-3367.

States M_r=(f*g)/T, the error √2M(3ℓ+1)2^{-p} and the cost. It uses the retained LB order (commutation of pointwise product with the record permutation, given in the motivation) and the 3δ+η error budget scaled by M, as at 3414-3473.

P_sF_s=2^{2α^2}B_0P_tF_tA with θ>p/α^4, the Gaussian maps and the Neumann-series left inverse, error p^2 and time O(tp^{3/2+δ}α), the tensor form with γ=2dα^2, and axis exposure O(Tpd^2(1+ℓ^τ)). All follow the paper.
Both identities are stated exactly. The coefficient comparison, the dilation substitution h=ck giving RF^+R=F^+, and the normalized convolution rule follow 3939-3983.

The exponents, sizes, α, γ=o(b), prime intervals, T/2<S<T and trial-division search are all correct. η=1/(4d) is never defined (it appears only implicitly through 'log x>8d'), and the consequence α^4θ_i>p is reduced to 'separation >η'.

The isomorphism x->∏x_i^{μ_i} with μ_i=P_i^{-1}, the triangular update order from d down to 1 by prefix-controlled rotations of the valid interval, and O(d^2) axis moves costing O(Tpd^2(1+ℓ^τ)) match the paper.
Well-definedness (ζy)^r=1, the diagonal isomorphism, the wrap factor ζ^{k+l}(-1)^h=ζ^j, and the twist-convolve-untwist with 2·2^{-p} phase approximations follow 4303-4392.

The source transform (expand, chirp transform, compress, scale by 2^γ, conjugate for the opposite sign) and the step list with scales S and 2^{2b+4}S match. A9 correctly explains the two occurrences of S.

Contraction and bilinear error propagation, the chirp 8TL bound, E_s=9·2^γTL with norm <.501, (3E_s+2) after the opposite transform, the final 448b2^{-3b/4}<1/2, and the carry invariant follow the paper's chain.
Normalization by V=Tp, seven dominant powers with margins g_i, min g_i=g_2=2^{-181}=2κ, absorption of fixed log powers, O(n(lg n)^{1-κ}), and schoolbook below a cutoff match 4810-4995.
R lists 'nlogn-conjecture' among its dependencies, but no step states the eventual lower bound or that one machine with liminf T(n)/(n lg n)=0 refutes it.

errors.says: With exponents chosen so that a=s/W<m^λ, the recurrence sums to O(e^λ).
errors.paper: Only the internal costs sum to O(e^λ). The leaves (e<d^β, F=O(e)) contribute O(e^σ d^{β(1-σ)}), which is why the final bound needs λ'>max{λ,σ+β(1-σ)}.
The second scale is 2^{2b+4}S, not 2^{2b+4}. The two occurrences of S undo different normalizations ((u*v)/S^2). A8 and A9 state this correctly.
The frame is C_U = H^{⊗m} diag_x(i^{q_U(x)}) H^{⊗m}, the diagonal phase conjugated by the Hadamard transform. The diagonal alone is not the frame.

errors.says: apply the f-fold forward child on each of the s_c residual-basis slots
errors.paper: Each edge applies one child per vector of its own residual basis (ρ_edge slots, h<=ρ_edge). The number s_c is the total over all edges of one network invocation, not a number of slots per edge.

chain: The tree reaches the main bound by the paper's route: scalar exchange network, frames, labels, bit and complex interfaces, the s<Wm saving and the exponent τ, then the power-width and arbitrary-width interchange, the phase-frame layer, transforms, convolution, resampling and chirp, assembly, exact recovery and the cost table. It thins out at the label budget (no L=Ich or Wm-2N+2L, and no N rank-one source exceptions in the rank count), at the exponent step (log m<20 is missing), and at the layer recurrence, where the leaf contribution that forces λ'>σ+β(1-σ) is dropped.

steps.note: The exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with every scratch wire restored is stated precisely. The defining sizes are absent: h=100, data indexed by triples a∈T^3, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 (only 'm-dimensional' appears). Rated conservatively.
A common frame commutes with the pointwise gate, the network implements D_out S D_in^{-1}, and each edge costs D_vD_u^{-1}. N2 also says that only the endpoint frames matter.
Nondegenerate subspaces of F^{⊗3} of dimension m, every edge joins comparable labels, and the only decreasing edges are central 3->4 losing h.

N4's method says that edge differences are projections onto residuals whose rank is the dimension change. The N exceptional source edges of rank one (2P_{U_a}) are not given, so the step lacks part of its defining content.
N4.1's deficit N-2L_b is equivalent to s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b. The budget sum |Δdim|=Wm-2N+2L and L=Ich are never stated; N3 says only that the total change is below Wm.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 below 1/2, leaving a strict saving, with deficit N-2L_b>0.
The endpoint identity M_sink(ρ(w))-M_source(w)=I_m with P_{U_a^⊥}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m, and the resulting shear H<-H+D on every row.
A=E_1ΠE_2, exactly a interchanges plus O(V) per edge, and s calls per node, all stated.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^τ with τ=1-2^{-50} from deficits above 20·2^{-50}, F_k=O(e^τ). The auxiliary fact log m<20 is omitted.

central.summary: The plan follows the chain from frames and labels to the endpoint identity, the strict saving, the recursive calls and the recurrence, so the mechanism of the saving is visible. It is weakest at the accounting that turns labels into the exact count s: the sizes h, N, m of the fixed network, the budget Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and the N rank-one source exceptions are missing or only implicit in the deficit N-2L_b.
